info.title: Horizon Realty Registration and Provider Onboarding API

post.description: Guest-only. Cookie/CSRF protected; default-off registration gate. Five/hour/IP and three/day/HMAC-canonical-email. New and duplicate valid requests share exactly the same 202. See pinned validation/fixtures.

name.description: Trim ASCII space, tab, CR and LF only before validation.

email.description: Trim ASCII edge whitespace and lowercase before validation; identity aliases are not rewritten.

password.description: Preserve bytes; reject the versioned local common-password list.

password_confirmation.description: Must exactly equal password; never persisted.

202.description: Generic acceptance; no delivery claim, no automatic login

500.description: Generic unavailable; committed outcome may be uncertain

parameters.description: Sanctum CSRF cookie/session flow; no bearer API token

post.description: Web session + CSRF. Generic 202 for verified/unverified. One/minute and five/hour/account, twenty/hour/IP. Independent of registration gate.

get.description: Matching authenticated web session, absolute configured-origin signed URL, expires after 60 minutes. Valid repeats preserve verification timestamp/audit. Ten/minute/account+IP.

200.description: EMAIL_VERIFIED; same response for valid replay

500.description: Generic unavailable; committed outcome may be uncertain

get.description: Authenticated self only. Explicit account readiness and own application summary allowlist; no contact/audit/token fields.

post.description: Verified self_provider only. Eligibility then independent default-off registration gate, then validation. 3/day/account. Matching normalized retry returns original 200; conflict returns APPLICATION_ALREADY_EXISTS. Gate disabled also rejects retries. Approved self_provider may recover matching existing application; no new application or conversion.

business_name.description: ASCII edge whitespace trimmed; Unicode code point lengths.

business_location.description: ASCII edge whitespace trimmed; Unicode code point lengths.

application_message.description: ASCII edge whitespace trimmed; Unicode code point lengths.

get.description: Current verified provisioned Administrator plus explicit review ability. Scope public provider onboarding applications before pagination. submitted_at DESC,id DESC. No implicit inquiry oversight.
Same review authorization. Missing/out-of-scope IDs yield identical APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND. Only detail includes applicant contact.

post.description: Current eligible reviewer; current password only. Regenerate session. Password failure 422 PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_FAILED. 5/minute/admin+IP. Server-side actor/password fingerprint bound to session; no returned token.

patch.description: Current verified provisioned Administrator + explicit review ability + confirmation within 600 seconds. 30/minute/admin+IP incl no-ops. Lock users by ascending ID, then application; recheck eligibility and confirmation under lock. Atomic role, final decision, immutable audit and durable notification intent. Same final decision/reason is a 200 no-op preserving original actor/time; conflict 409 APPLICATION_DECISION_CONFLICT. No ownership/inquiry grants.

message.const: If this request can be processed, check your email or sign in to continue.
If needed, a verification email will be requested.

x-error-codes.403: FORBIDDEN; EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED for unverified provider applicant; REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED for stale/missing Administrator confirmation; VERIFICATION_LINK_INVALID for invalid verification links
x-error-codes.503: REGISTRATION_DISABLED for register/new application (including matching retries)
